research_scope.use_case: review an already generated, fixed question-answer bundle
research_scope.verification_unit: one automatically enumerated numeric source-text span
research_scope.cost_unit: one inspected candidate, whether or not it is erroneous or repaired
research_scope.repair_model: ideal exact correction from evaluation-only repair labels
research_scope.human_claim: none; this does not estimate human repair success or time
research_scope.data_claim: controlled text corruption only; not multimodal and not naturally occurring parser error

dataset.source: FinanceBench public release pinned by the prepared dataset manifest
dataset.question_selection_note: Two fixed Boeing questions are used to exercise distinct retrieval dependencies while keeping the local call budget small. Selection is exploratory and is not an independent evaluation sample.
dataset.tuning: none; formulas, budgets, and tie-breaking are frozen before the live run
dataset.reuse_rule: Outputs inspected during this pilot cannot later be relabeled as an independent confirmatory test. Any design change requires a new spec_id and change reason.

initial_runs.cache_rule: Every condition invokes a new runner process and must have a unique pipeline_execution_id. no_op may not reuse baseline output.
initial_runs.targeted_condition_role: A, B, and AB are oracle-location plumbing checks, not selectable-policy baselines. AB is an actual simultaneous correction and rerun.

first_live_call_budget.derivation: 5 targeted conditions plus 4 policies times 2 budgets; passthrough synthesis; 2 QA calls per execution

candidate_generation.timing: after baseline and no_op records exist, before repair labels are joined
allowed_inputs: corrupted source blocks and their IDs/pages
baseline and no_op trace nodes, retrieval scores, answers, and cited source IDs
candidate_generation.eligible_chunks: union of chunks retrieved for a question in baseline or no_op
candidate_generation.deduplication: same source block and span is one candidate even if overlapping chunks or both initial runs retrieve it
candidate_generation.normal_candidates: all enumerated candidates remain eligible; candidates without an evaluation repair label consume cost and cause no edit
candidate_generation.repair_label_join: performed only after a policy selection is frozen and serialized
candidate_generation.validity_gate: fail if the universe contains only repair-labeled candidates or if a repair label was present in serialized policy input

edge_types.candidate_in_block: candidate source span belongs to one source block
edge_types.candidate_to_chunk: candidate span overlaps a deterministic passthrough chunk span

provenance_graph.generation_evidence: saved baseline/no_op runner traces and frozen corrupted blocks
provenance_graph.descendant_questions: questions reached by candidate_to_chunk followed by chunk_to_question in either policy-visible initial run
provenance_graph.limitation: Exact source-span overlap is valid only for synthesis_mode=passthrough. Model synthesis lineage is not eligible in v1. Graph reach is structural association, not causal recovery.

availability.parser_disagreement: unavailable because the pilot has one pypdf text output
availability.parser_confidence: unavailable because pypdf page blocks have no confidence
availability.initial_run_instability: available from independently executed baseline and no_op

features.jaccard_empty_rule: J(empty, empty)=1; otherwise intersection size divided by union size
features.question_instability: u_q = 0.5 * I(normalized baseline answer != normalized no_op answer) + 0.5 * (1 - J(baseline evidence_block_ids, no_op evidence_block_ids))
features.error_risk: risk_i = (1 + sum_{q in D_i} u_q) / (2 + |D_i|), a frozen Laplace-smoothed instability proxy; it is not calibrated parser-error probability
features.structural_reach: reach_i = |D_i| / |Q|, where D_i is the candidate's descendant-question set
features.shared_dependency: overlap(i,j) = |D_i intersect D_j| / |D_i union D_j|, with zero for an empty union
features.expected_repairability: repairability_i = 1.0 for every candidate, conditional on an error being present, because v1 simulates ideal exact correction; it is neither learned nor an observed downstream effect
features.actual_effect_rule: post-repair recovery, regression, and interaction are evaluation-only fields and never policy features

policies.budget_rule: sum of selected candidate costs must not exceed the integer budget

random.rule: uniform seeded permutation of the common candidate universe; take the longest affordable prefix

individual_impact.rule: descending fixed score independent of the selected set

graph_aware.marginal_score: risk_i * repairability_i / (cost_i * |Q|) * sum_{q in D_i}(1 / (1 + n_S(q)))
graph_aware.rule: greedy recomputation after each choice; n_S(q) is the count of already selected candidates structurally reaching q
graph_aware.interpretation: overlapping graph descendants are discounted as an estimate of redundant attention, not asserted to equal actual recovery overlap

policies.oracle: not a selectable policy in v1; targeted A/B/AB runs are reported separately as unattainable location-aware plumbing references
policies.output_only: PROPOSED and not comparable in v1 because no cost-matched downstream-output correction unit has been defined
policies.multi_stage_allocation: PROPOSED; v1 candidates are upstream parsing-text spans only

intervention_and_rerun.selection_freeze: write candidate universe, features, graph, scores, and selected IDs before accessing repair labels
intervention_and_rerun.inspection: every selected candidate incurs cost one
intervention_and_rerun.normal_candidate: record inspected_no_change and rerun the downstream pipeline without editing
intervention_and_rerun.repair_candidate: apply the evaluation-only exact source-span replacement after selection
intervention_and_rerun.rerun_scope: fresh passthrough chunking, BM25 retrieval, and QA for the fixed questions
intervention_and_rerun.forbidden_reuse: no prior model response may substitute for any policy-budget execution
intervention_and_rerun.integrity: record selected-set hash, input/output hash, unique execution IDs, model runtime identity, prompt/config/code provenance

evaluation.separation: gold and repair labels are loaded only by judgment-template/score steps, not selection
evaluation.judgment_unit: one generated answer and its cited evidence for one execution-question
evaluation.blind_fields: judgment template omits policy, budget, targeted condition, repeat, and repair-applied status
evaluation.answer_rule: For the two frozen FinanceBench questions, preserve conclusion direction and all material referenced numeric values; signs and units must agree. Equivalent wording is allowed.
evaluation.numeric_rule: exact values after normalization of commas/currency/percent formatting; no additional tolerance in v1
evaluation.evidence_rule: cited source block text must support the material answer. Gold page is a reference, not the only allowed source if another cited block genuinely supports the answer.
evaluation.failure_rule: runner failure, timeout, missing answer, invalid evidence ID, incomplete metadata, missing judgment, or integrity mismatch is not success and blocks the aggregate
evaluation.no_op_metric: no_op net change relative to baseline within the repeat
evaluation.interaction: I(A,B)=G(AB)-G(A)-G(B), using the actual AB simultaneous rerun
evaluation.graph_vs_actual: record structural descendant overlap separately from recovery-set overlap and interaction; do not infer equality
evaluation.uncertainty: none for this one-document one-repeat wiring pilot; no confidence interval or population claim

can_check: budget accounting including normal inspected candidates
policy set selection and graph-overlap discount mechanics
traceable local-model outputs and paired descriptive recovery metrics
cannot_check: calibrated error risk or expected repairability
multiple real parsers or naturally occurring errors
cross-stage allocation or fair output-only comparison

remaining_abstract_requirements.requirement: naturally occurring parser errors and grounded corruption taxonomy
allocation across parsing, synthesis, and downstream stages
paper result tables, uncertainty, and limitations analysis
